title: Find a lowest common ancestor and path distances
statement: Find the lowest common ancestor of node ID limit and the largest node ID in the forest. Return its ID and the edge distances from it to the selected node and to the largest-ID node. Return (0,-1,-1) if the forest is empty, the selected node is absent, or they belong to different roots.
constraints: Unique positive IDs, 0 <= parent < node, and every nonzero parent exists. Forest is finite and acyclic; rows may be shuffled.
Use the exact declared Entry and Report record fields and solve signature. Return all three Report fields; do not mutate the caller's records.
All arithmetic fits signed int64; there are at most 30 records. limit is in [0, 30]. Return fresh results; no I/O, tests, exceptions, panic, or static-check bypasses.

jett.signature:
namespace benchmark

struct Entry:
    node: int64
    parent: int64

struct Report:
    ancestor: int64
    selected_distance: int64
    largest_distance: int64

function solve(view rows: list[Entry], limit: int64) returns Report
